Skill Strong knowledge of at least one JavaScript UI framework
 Location Warren, NJ
 Total Experience 2 yrs.
 Max Salary Not Mentioned
 Employment Type Direct Jobs (Full Time)
 Domain Any
 Description
 OPT and EAD can apply 
 

 Qualifications: 
 

 Strong understanding of HTTP protocol, RESTful service methodologies, HTML5, and Javascript/AJAX 
 Strong knowledge of at least one JavaScript UI framework (Kendo UI strongly preferred) 
 Experience creating reusable JavaScript UI components 
 Ability to leverage browser debug tools to troubleshoot Javascript code and asynchronous data calls 
 High quality production code for client facing applications 
 Documentation of application features 
 

 Functional skillset desired: 
 

 Read business requirements and software specifications. 
 Write code to existing requirements with minimal supervision. 
 Review and refactor code to adhere to company coding standards.


 Multiple Openings for OPT/CPT/H4/L2/EAD/Citizen's.
